verdict.rationale: Publishing an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a knowledge-base app, so the axis applies. The only probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at plugins-doc.logseq.com/llms.txt), and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation. The local HTTP API docs and the community-run plugin API docs are general developer references, which are adjacent and earn no credit.
